skill.name: email-verification
skill.description: Verify user-provided email addresses through a connected FairValid workspace. Review job status and results, check available credits, or cancel an authorized job.
skill.summary: Verify email addresses and review FairValid jobs, results, and credits.
skill.author: moonlitnayeem

security_audit.summary: The shell, reconnaissance, and path traversal alerts match Markdown notation, workflow language, or a fixed documentation link. Live verification sends user-provided addresses to the disclosed FairValid service, and the retry instructions do not define how long to keep those addresses. No evidence of prompt injection or covert data transfer was found.

remediation.issue: Live verification shares email addresses with FairValid and may reserve workspace credits.
remediation.suggestion: State the recipient, address count, and possible credit reservation before submission. Require confirmation when the user has not clearly approved the live transfer.

remediation.issue: Retry instructions do not define storage or retention limits for exact inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Keep retry inputs in protected, workspace-scoped state only while admission may need reconciliation. Do not copy them into logs or ordinary files.

content.value_statement: Email lists can contain invalid addresses, and pending checks can be mistaken for final results. Use FairValid to verify addresses you provide, track jobs, and interpret results.
actual_capabilities: Submit one supplied email address or a batch of up to 5,000 addresses for verification.
Check an existing job by ID and report whether it is still running.
Read paginated results and distinguish final outcomes from pending or unchecked addresses.
Check available workspace credits with the required balance permission.
Request cancellation of a job when the user authorizes it.
Demonstrate the workflow with documented fixtures on a confirmed Test-key connection.
limitations: Live verification sends the supplied addresses to FairValid and requires a connected workspace with the appropriate permissions.
Live jobs run asynchronously. An accepted submission can still be pending when the interaction ends.
A Valid result does not guarantee inbox delivery. Unknown and unresolved catch-all results do not establish validity.
The skill does not discover leads, scrape contacts, or expand an address list.

use_cases.title: Check a mailing list
use_cases.description: Submit an authorized list and separate invalid addresses from addresses that still need review.

use_cases.title: Review an existing verification job
use_cases.description: Use a job ID to explain completed results and identify addresses that are still pending or were not checked.

use_cases.title: Check credit availability
use_cases.description: Read the connected workspace balance before approving a live batch without submitting any addresses.

prompt_templates.title: Check available credits
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the credit balance for my connected FairValid workspace. Do not submit any addresses.
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to know the available balance before requesting verification.

prompt_templates.title: Verify one approved address
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the possible credit cost, then verify [approved email address] in my connected FairValid workspace. Report the job ID if the result is pending.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have one address approved for live verification.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize an existing batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review FairValid job [job ID] and read all available result pages. Report counts by outcome without listing individual addresses. Do not start another job.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a status report for a previously submitted batch.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile a timed-out submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether the timed-out FairValid submission was accepted. Retry only with the same connection identity, original key, and unchanged inputs. If that is not possible, report the uncertainty without starting a replacement.
prompt_templates.scenario: A live batch submission timed out and you want to avoid duplicate charges.

output_examples.input: Report the status of an accepted verification job that is still running.
output_examples.output: FairValid accepted the job and is still checking the address. No final mailbox result is available yet.

output_examples.input: Summarize a completed batch without exposing the addresses.
output: Eight addresses returned Valid and one returned Invalid.
One returned Unknown and should not be treated as valid.

output_examples.input: Check the workspace balance without verifying any addresses.
output_examples.output: The connected workspace has 120 available credits. No addresses were submitted for verification.

best_practices: Confirm the exact address list before live submission and explain when credits may be reserved or used.
Keep a record of the job ID. Retain retry inputs securely only as long as needed to reconcile the submission.
Use documented fixture addresses on a confirmed Test-key connection for demonstrations.
anti_patterns: Do not assume that connecting or testing the integration authorizes live verification of customer addresses.
Do not silently correct or expand the submitted list. Ask before checking a replacement address.
Do not retry an uncertain submission with changed inputs, credentials, or a new retry key.

faq.question: What connection do I need?
faq.answer: Connect FairValid to an MCP-capable client and approve the workspace connection. Use a separate direct Test-key connection for sandbox demonstrations.

faq.question: How many addresses can I submit?
faq.answer: You can submit one address or a batch of up to 5,000. Larger approved lists require separate batches.

faq.question: How are live checks charged?
faq.answer: Live submissions may reserve credits. Each completed Valid or Invalid check uses one credit. Genuine Unknown, unresolved catch-all, failed, and unprocessed checks have no net charge.

faq.question: Does Valid guarantee that my email will arrive?
faq.answer: No. A Valid result does not guarantee inbox delivery.

faq.question: Can I cancel a running job?
faq.answer: Yes, if you authorize cancellation for that job. Checks already in progress may finish, and completed checks retain their normal credit treatment.

faq.question: Can I test the workflow without using live addresses?
faq.answer: Yes. Use documented fixtures on a confirmed Test-key connection. OAuth connects to live workspace data.
